title: Use adjudicated flags when verifying passes.
comment:
**Use adjudicated flags when verifying passes.**

If the scorers disagree and adjudication changes a blocker flag, `tally.mts` counts the adjudicated result, but this line counts the operator result. The verifier then rejects a correct tally. Select the same final flags that `tally.mts` uses before calculating `passes`.

title: Prevent a second run from appending to an existing sample file.
comment:
**Prevent a second run from appending to an existing sample file.**

If an operator repeats `run --execute` after an interrupted run, `appendFileSync` adds duplicate sample rows. `verify.mts` then rejects the run because the row count exceeds `plan.samples.total`. Reject an existing run before paid calls start, or implement an explicit resume path.
